_doc: Villager kinds: names, lines, trades (give -> get), tasks (bring need -> reward). Villagers retreat to their home point when a hazard warning starts; a bad home kills them like anyone else.

greetings: You climbed up. Good. Most don't.
warnings: We camp up here because the lakes breathe. When the water bubbles, climb. Never sleep low.
The gas hugs the ground like a dog. Walls that hold air hold it out. Thatch doesn't.
The animals go first. When you see them lie down by the water, you have a minute.
lore: There was a village on the shore once. The stones are still there, under the fog.
My grandmother said the lake was asleep for forty years. Then it wasn't.

tasks.text: The tents need rope. Bring me 8 fiber.
tasks.done: Good hands. Take these; they hold air.

tasks.text: Our filters are spent. Two charcoal and I'll pay in glass.
tasks.done: Now we can see the lake from inside.

greetings: Mind the ladder. Everything that matters is up here.
warnings: When the tide goes out too far, it is coming back with friends. Get up high, then seal the door.
The roaches climb. Stone keeps them out; planks don't, the gaps are enough.
Fire. They hate fire. A ring of it buys you a night.
lore: We used to live on the sand. The sand is where the roaches sleep.
The old ones say the storm counts the days with you. It gets worse as you get better.

tasks.text: Steam me four shellfish and I'll give you stone for a wall.
tasks.done: Salt and smoke. Here, build something that holds.
That'll hold through one more storm.

greetings: Down here. Quick. You're letting the dusk in.
warnings: When the moon's edge glows, you have a minute to get under stone. Not glass. Not wood. Stone or earth.
The shadows on the barn wall were people. They waited to see what the light was.
Dig. Dig is always right. The sun cannot look around a corner.
lore: The farms died in one afternoon. The cellars did not.
We plant under the barn roof now, with lanterns. It tastes of nothing. It is food.

tasks.text: The cellar wall is thin on the east side. Bring 6 cobble.
tasks.done: That side will hold now. Take the kit; we've used ours.

tasks.text: Charcoal for the lamps. Four pieces.
tasks.done: Light we choose, not light that chooses us.

greetings: You walk tall. That is a habit to lose here.
warnings: Build low. Build stone. The walkers do not look down.
When the ground hums, get under rock. Not wood. Rock. Wood is a lid on a pot.
They are not angry. They are just heavy. Nothing you can build will stop a foot; only hold it up.
Our domes are dug in. A foot on the roof is a bad day, not a last one.
lore: Nobody has seen one sit down. Nobody has seen one eat.
The old road to the east is a line of footprints now. You can grow things in them.
Dov says they hum to each other through the ground. Dov says a lot of things.

tasks.text: The west dome cracked. Bring me 10 cobble and I'll pay in bricks.
tasks.done: Good stone. The bricks hold weight too, if you lay them thick.

tasks.text: The cold is coming. Four cooked meat.
tasks.done: That'll keep the little ones warm. Take this; we patch ourselves up a lot here.
